title: Enterprise Support: Handling conditions for source-line debit assessment
content:
Enterprise Support — Handling conditions for source-line debit assessment.

## Handling condition

For source-line debit assessment: Before booking the source-line support debit, its corrected-fee review must be completed with approved status and incorrect decision, including the reconciled physical quantity.

For source-line debit assessment: The reconstructed subtotal must agree with its approved review before a debit is permitted.
